messages:
Jess: Quick kickoff for AlphaRetail pilot — we need final use-case ranking (top 3), clear success metrics, and a workable 4-week pilot timeline. Also capture procurement security + pricing asks.
Sam S-E: Agree. I'll do impact vs effort scoring and give dev day estimates.
Anya (AlphaRetail): Our priority order: 1) Checkout assist (assist at checkout flows), 2) Product search relevance, 3) Abandoned-cart recovery. Rerank recs optional.
Mike: Good. Call out minimal endpoints we can prototype and I'll start wiring a minimal adapter.
Anya (AlphaRetail): Checkout assist and product search must be in pilot. Abandoned-cart recovery is secondary but expected.
Olivia: Minimal endpoint suggestions:
```
POST /v1/generate/checkout-assist
POST /v1/embeddings/product-search
POST /v1/rerank/recommendations
```
Sam S-E: Effort estimates (rough): generate + embeddings = 1-2 dev days each for a basic flow. Rerank online low-latency is heavier: 3-4 days.
Jess: Proposed success criteria per use case:
- Checkout assist: conversion lift >= 3% vs baseline OR support tickets about checkout down 15%
- Product search: NDCG@10 >= +12% vs current, SKU exact-match >= 95%
- Abandoned-cart: recovery lift >= 5% for the pilot cohort
Mike: Performance SLO targets for pilot: generate p95 < 300ms (dedicated), embeddings p95 < 150ms, rerank p95 < 250ms.
Sam S-E: Eval plan (suggested): collect ~200 labeled prompts per use case, hold out 10% for validation; automated metrics + 50 human checks; pass threshold = combined >= 80%
Anya (AlphaRetail): Sounds fair. Timeline?
Jess: Tentative 4-week timeline:
W0 (this week): data handoff, security questionnaire answers stub, share SSO metadata
W1: endpoint integration + smoke tests; sales to get pricing note to procurement by EOW
W2: run evals, iterate prompts, collect human checks
W3: performance tuning (batching, quant), cost analysis
W4: final acceptance, runbook + handoff to AlphaRetail ops
Ryan (PM): Sales needs a short pilot quote for procurement by end of W1. They asked about pilot discounts and embedding unit pricing.
Sam S-E: Pricing draft: pilot = hosted per-token + embeddings; offer 30% pilot discount. Option to convert to Dedicated with committed monthly GPU credits (discount bands TBD).
security-bot: Security checklist: EU data residency? SSO (SAML/OIDC)? KMS support? retention and deletion policy? Will PII be sent to hosted endpoints? Need answers.
Anya (AlphaRetail): EU residency required and will confirm PII scope. SSO via SAML must be supported.
Olivia: For EU residency we can offer a eu-west Dedicated sandbox or Private VPC trial. VPC networking prep ~3 business days.
Mike: Integration notes: ensure canonical SKU passed to avoid tokenization mismatches; preserve session prefix for continuity and caching.
Sam S-E: Prompt/eval note: request 50k search logs, sample 500 for prompt authoring and 200 for eval as a starting point.
Jess: Deliverables this week: 1) pilot quote draft, 2) security Q answers stub, 3) integration checklist + sample data spec.
Anya (AlphaRetail): I'll upload sample search logs plus SAML metadata by EOD tomorrow.
Mike: I'll provision a dev sandbox and share dev-only API keys when I have sample data.
Olivia: @deploy-bot can you provision a eu-west sandbox mirroring Dedicated (1x A10G mock)?
deploy-bot: Received. Provisioning eu-west sandbox now. ETA ~48h.
Sam S-E: Pricing question for ops: if AlphaRetail commits to 3-months reserved capacity, what's the likely discount band? Ops usually 25-40% depending on commit level — will confirm.
security-bot: Also ask for SOC2 evidence and encryption details (in transit & at rest) for procurement. Provide compliance pack links.
Jess: Thanks team. Next check-in Friday 10am PT. If anything blocks before then, flag in-thread. :thumbsup:
